data.body: Fixed: Added origin/main sync step in _phase_merge (plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh) before branch push. Uses git fetch + git merge-base --is-ancestor to detect when branch is behind origin/main (has a common ancestor), then git merge --no-edit origin/main to incorporate new main commits before PR creation. Conflict surfaces at create-time rather than merge-queue time. No-common-ancestor case is skipped safely (unrelated histories). Also added regression test t_pr_syncs_origin_main_before_push in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh that confirms the hotfix commit from main is present in the branch HEAD after the script runs.
